propositions: An ADR must document three committed-format changes to .bridge_state (A2: last_get_pass relocation, A3: scalar baseline normalization, A4-2: prev_snapshot narrowing) and one field deletion (A1: baseline_advanced_at removal).
Bridge state remains committed on the tickets branch because ephemeral GitHub runners require durable state; off-branch relocation was rejected by epic 6c9c.
The mixed-version protocol reads chronological max(new, legacy) to safely handle concurrent old and new writers, and stops legacy writes only after direct deployment evidence; first-wins is unsafe.

The A2-2 cutover gate requires A2-1 merged on main, a successful descendant reconcile-bridge.yml run, explicit host-probe refresh with no older process, and the old/new-writer self-healing oracle; no pass-record version stamp is available.

Each format change has defined rollback boundaries: A2-1 reversible; A3 reversible via idempotent canonicalization; A2-2 supports rollback only to A2-1-or-newer; A4-2 requires recorded forward and reverse corpus evidence.
Measured marginal cost is 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB after A1, with 218/399 identical prev key sets; assignee remains raw because _assignee_candidates requires its original shape.
